scenarios.name: Baseline Operational Scenario
scenarios.label: PROJECTED
keyAssumptions: Provider API latency remains within nominal bounds (500ms - 2000ms)
Worker agents are unblocked and responsive

outcome.expectedOutcome: Option 'Conservative Sequential Execution' executes under expected operational conditions.
outcome.label: PROJECTED
outcome.recoveryImplications: Fully recoverable with clean checkpoint rollback

outcome.expectedOutcome: Maximum efficiency: task finishes early with superior quality.
outcome.label: PROJECTED

scenarios.name: Constrained Resource Scenario
scenarios.label: PROJECTED
keyAssumptions: Concurrent execution quota restricted by ResourceGovernor
Worker agents queue for available provider leases

outcome.expectedOutcome: Option execution delayed due to rate limiting or resource arbitration holds.
outcome.label: PROJECTED
outcome.resourceImpact: High contention on shared gateway slots.

scenarios.name: Fault & Degradation Scenario
scenarios.label: PROJECTED
keyAssumptions: Upstream provider failure triggers fallback routing or error classification

outcome.expectedOutcome: Task encounters execution failure; recovery policy required.
outcome.label: PROJECTED
outcome.recoveryImplications: Automatic rollback to last valid checkpoint via Stage 09 durable recovery.

scenarios.name: Deadline Pressure Scenario
scenarios.label: PROJECTED
keyAssumptions: Strict deadline cannot be extended; operator requires immediate delivery

outcome.expectedOutcome: Sequential execution risks missing the target deadline without acceleration.
outcome.label: PROJECTED
outcome.deadlineImpact: Requires trade-off between speed and deep verification.

scenarios.name: Budget Pressure Scenario
scenarios.label: PROJECTED
keyAssumptions: Operational cost ceiling strictly enforced by ResourceGovernor

outcome.expectedOutcome: Maintains strict cost control within budget limits.
outcome.label: PROJECTED
outcome.resourceImpact: Budget throttling activated; expensive model routing prohibited.
